@note: Draft translation, not yet reviewed by a native speaker
pc.name: Amafu amaphoyinti
pc.privacy: Ifayela nelifu akuhambi kulesi sikhompyutha. Ifayela lifundwa lapha, bese amathayela agcinwa ku-storage yale bhrawuza; akulayishwa lutho.
pc.numbers: Konke lapha kubika kuyinombolo evela kudatha yakho, hhayi isitifiketi. Umuntu ogunyaziwe unquma ukuthi kusiza ngani.
pc.file: Ifayela lephoyinti lefu (LAS, LAZ, E57, PLY, PCD, PTX, XYZ noma PTS)
pc.stopped: Kumile. Ukwakha kugcina lokho okuqedile; cindezela Qhubeka ukuze uqhubeke.
pc.info.short: Ukwakha kudinga cishe {need} kodwa le bhrawuza ingagcina {free}. Khulula isikhala noma sebenzisa ifayela elincane.
pc.where.hint: Ifu elikhulu lithatha isikhala esifana nefayela lalo. Khetha ifolda enesikhala, isibonelo ifolda ye-CadCraft clouds ku-Documents; amafu asevele akhiwe ahlala lapho akhiwe khona.
pc.o.what: Faka i-orthomosaic yedrone emhlabeni nasepulanini. Iba yungqimba lwemephu lweprojekthi (i-GeoTIFF, noma i-PNG noma i-JPEG enefayela layo lomhlaba), ukuze ipulani liyibonise ngaphansi komdwebo, nombono we-3D uyipendulele emhlabeni owakhe. Akha umhlaba kuqala.
pc.o.file.hint: Khetha isithombe kanye nefayela layo lomhlaba (kanye ne-.prj uma inalo). Isithombe esikhulu kakhulu sincishiswa saba ama-megapixel angu-16.
pc.o.reading: Ifunda isithombe. Uma uhlelo lubuza ukuthi amaphuzu alo alungelelaniswe kanjani, liphendule: uhlelo lweprojekthi lwayo, noma khetha olunye. (Ifayela le-.prj okhethwe kanye nesithombe liphendula ngokwalo.)
pc.o.none: Akukho sithombe esengeziwe. Umlayezo ongaphezulu komdwebo uchaza ukuthi kungani.
pc.o.added.nocloud: {name} engeziwe njengongqimba lwemephu. Vula ifu ukuze uhlole ukuthi liyilele phezulu kwalo.
pc.o.nocrs: Ifayela alinalo uhlelo lokuxhumanisa, ngakho libekwe ezixhumanisweni zeprojekthi ngokwayo.
pc.o.nooverlap: {name} ayilele phezu kwefu. Imbangela ejwayelekile uhlelo lokuxhumanisa oluhlukile: susa ungqimba ku-Map layers bese uyengeza futhi ngefayela layo le-.prj.
pc.o.needground: Cindezela Akha umhlaba: isithombe sipendulelwe phezu komhlaba.
pc.list.empty: Awukho amafu okwamanje. Vula ifayela phezulu.
pc.list.resume.hint: Khetha lelo fayela futhi, bese ucindezela Qhubeka.
pc.remove.title: Susa lelu fu?
pc.remove.body: {name} izosuswa ku-storage yale bhrawuza. Ifayela olivulile alithintwa.
pc.stats: {drawn} kwamaphoyinti angafika ku-{budget} adwetshiwe · amathayela angu-{nodes} abonisiwe, {loading} alindile · {mb} MB igcinwe
pc.clean.hint: Dweba umugqa epulanini, noma ku-3D kusukela kumbono ophezulu. Ku-3D umugqa uyehliselwa ezingeni elilinganayo, ngakho ukhetha insika eme phezulu. Inani elingaphansi libonakala ngaphambi kokuthi kushintshwe lutho.
pc.clean.draw.lasso: Cindezela, hudula uzungeze amaphoyinti, bese ukhulula. Esc ikhansela.
pc.clean.draw.box: Cindezela ekhoneni elilodwa, hudula uye ekhoneni elibhekene nalo, bese ukhulula. Esc ikhansela.
pc.clean.draw.polygon: Chofoza amakhona; chofoza kabili noma Enter uvale. Esc ikhansela.
pc.big.title: Lokho kungaphezu kwesigamu sefu
pc.big.body: Lokhu kushintsha amaphoyinti angu-{n}, u-{pct} % wefu. Kungabuyiselwa. Qhubeka?
pc.log.title: Okuhlelwe kuze kube manje (ifayela ngokwalo alishintshwa)
pc.noise.title: Thola umsindo
pc.noise.what: Imaka amaphoyinti azulazulayo njengamaphoyinti angaphansi (isigaba 7) noma umsindo omkhulu (isigaba 18). Akukho okusulwayo uma ungakhethanga ibhokisi. Isinyathelo esisodwa sokuhlehlisa.
pc.noise.radius.hint: Ngamayunithi efayela. Amaphoyinti abalwa njengabanakhelwane angaphakathi kwalo kude.
pc.noise.min.hint: Ahlukile: iphoyinti elinabanakhelwane abambalwa kunalokhu liyisimo sosindo.
pc.noise.k.hint: Ngezibalo: ibanga eliphakathi kumaphoyinti ambalwa aseduze kakhulu.
pc.noise.sd.hint: Ngezibalo: okude kunephakathi kuphakamisa lokhu kuyimsindo.
pc.noise.done: Kumakiwe amaphoyinti angu-{n} ({low} aphansi, {high} aphakeme) ngo-{ms} ms.
pc.g.what: Ithola umhlaba ithayela ngethayela (amathayela angu-256 m anokuhlanganisa), iqhathanise iphoyinti ngalinye nawo bese imaka umhlaba (isigaba 2) namaphoyinti aphansi (isigaba 7). Isinyathelo esisodwa sokuhlehlisa.
pc.g.cell.hint: Usayizi wegridi wokusesha iphoyinti eliphansi kakhulu, ngamayunithi efayela.
pc.g.tol.hint: Iphoyinti eseduze kwalo mhlaba otholakele kakhulu libizwa ngokuthi ngumhlaba.
pc.g.slope.hint: Ukuthambeka okukhulu kakhulu komhlaba okufanele isihlungi silandele (ukuphakama ngokuhamba).
pc.g.obj.hint: Izakhiwo ezibanzi kunalokhu amaseli angaka ziyasuswa emhlabeni.
pc.g.label: Ukuhlukaniswa komhlaba
pc.c.label: Izigaba zotshani nezakhiwo
pc.g.done: Umhlaba: amaphoyinti angu-{ground}, amaphoyinti aphansi: {noise}, amathayela angu-{tiles}, {ms} ms.
pc.g.seams: Imiphetho yamathayela angu-{n} ayahlukana ngaphezu kwesigamu sokubekezelela. Yibheke ngaphambi kokuthembela umhlaba lapho.
pc.g.seams.none: Akukho mphetho yethayela ehlukana ngaphezu kwesigamu sokubekezelela.
pc.c.done: Utshani obuphansi {low}, obumaphakathi {mid}, ezinde {high}, izakhiwo {building} ({ms} ms).
pc.s.what: Yakha umhlaba osukhona kumaphoyinti abizwa ngokuthi ngumhlaba, bese iqhathanisa lawo maphoyinti nawo. Umhlaba wengezwa ku-projekthi njengoba ukungenisa kwe-LAS kwenza (amaphoyinti achazwa njenge-GROUND), njengesinyathelo esisodwa sokuhlehlisa.
pc.s.maxedge: Eyona nxanxathela ende yenxantathu (0 = akukho umkhawulo)
pc.s.maxedge.hint: Izinxantathu ezinenxanxathela ende kakhulu ziyashiywa, isibonelo phezu kwamanzi.
pc.s.done: Kusetshenzisiwe amaphoyinti angu-{kept} womhlaba kwangu-{seen}; amaphoyinti angu-{points} engezwe kuprojekthi, izinxantathu ezingu-{tris}.
pc.s.capped: Kufinyelelwe umkhawulo wamaphoyinti; amanye amaphoyinti omhlaba ashiywe.
pc.r.honest: Lezi yizinombolo zalelu fu nalo mhlaba. Azisiyo isitifiketi sanoma yini.
pc.r.worst: Izindawo eziyishumi ezehluka kakhulu (chofoza ukuze uya lapho)
pc.bl.title: Imigqa yokuphuka
pc.bl.hint: Chofoza amaphoyinti angaphansi kwe-kerb, emfudlaneni noma phezulu ebhange ku-3D. Ukuchofoza ngakunye kuthatha iphoyinti eliseduze kakhulu elidwetshiwe.
pc.bl.planhint: Chofoza kuya ku-kerb, emfudlaneni noma phezulu ebhange epulanini. Chofoza kabili noma Enter uqede umugqa, Esc ikhansela. Ukuchofoza ngakunye kuthatha iphoyinti lefu eliseduze, okokuqala elomhlaba.
pc.bl.planfew: Ukuchofoza okungaphansi kwabili kuthole iphoyinti lefu. Chofoza eduze namaphoyinti, noma sondeza.
pc.bl.plansaved: Umugqa wokuphuka ugciniwe namaphoyinti angu-{n} ({skipped} wokuchofoza wawungenaphoyinti lefu eduze). Ukuakha umhlaba okulandelayo ukusebenzisa.
pc.c.preview: Imigqa yekhonthuwa phezu kwefu, ibukwe phezulu
pc.bl.saved: Umugqa wokuphuka ugciniwe; ukuakha umhlaba okulandelayo ukuwusebenzisa.
pc.c.out: Imigqa yekhonthuwa engu-{n} kusukela ku-{lo} kuya ku-{hi}, njalo ngo-{step}.
pc.c.none: Awukho amakhonthuwa okwamanje. Akha umhlaba kuqala.
pc.v.title: Ivolumu yesitaki
pc.v.what: Ivolumu yomphezulu ngaphezu kwesisekelo ngaphakathi komngcele odwetshiwe. Umngcele kufanele uzungeze isitaki emhlabeni.
pc.v.draw: Chofoza amakhona azungeze isitaki; chofoza kabili noma Enter uvale.
pc.v.leaves: Umngcele uphuma kumininingwane: amayunithi ayisikwele angu-{area} awanaphezulu futhi awabalwa.
pc.f.title: Ivolumu phakathi kwezindiza ezimbili
pc.f.what: Yakha umhlaba wa-{a} nowefu elinye bese iwuqhathanisa. Gcwalisa kuyindawo lapho indiza yesibili iphakeme khona, Sika lapho iphansi khona.
pc.f.none: Akha ifu lesibili kuqala. Liyavela lapha ohlwini.
pc.x.title: Hlinzeka ifayela le-LAS noma le-LAZ elihlanziwe
pc.x.what: Ibhala ifu elinokuhlelwa kwakho nezigaba ezisetshenziswe njengefayela elisha. Ifayela lokuqala alishintshwa.
pc.x.laz.what: I-LAZ ingu-LAS ocindezelwe ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa: wonke amaphoyinti ayabuya ngokuphelele. Ibhalwa njengefomethi yephoyinti 0, noma 2 nombala, efayeleni le-LAS 1.4, ngomcindezeli wa-CadCraft ngokwawo.
pc.x.done.file: Alondoloziwe amaphoyinti {n} ({size}) kulo ifayela olikhethile, abhalwa njengoba eqhubeka.
pc.x.stream: Uyakhetha ifayela kuqala; amaphoyinti bese ebhalelwa kulo njengoba efundwa, ngakho ifu elikhulu kakhulu alidingi ukuba lingene enkumbulweni.
pc.x.big: Lesi sisheshisi asikwazi ukubhala ifayela njengoba siqhubeka, ngakho sonke isiphumo (cishe {size}) siqoqelwa enkumbulweni kuqala. Sebenzisa i-Chrome, i-Edge noma uhlelo lwe-Studio ukuze uphume ifu elikhulu kangaka, noma uphume ingxenye yesifunda noma umhlabathi kuphela.
pc.x.ratio: Ifayela liyizinga lamaphesenti {pct} % lamaphoyinti afanayo ne-LAS.
pc.sec.what: Dweba umugqa ngaphesheya komsele, umphetho wendlela noma uhlamvu: amaphoyinti angaphakathi kwesigamu sobubanzi balo adwetshwe ngokumelene nebanga nokuphakama.
pc.sec.out: Amaphoyinti: {n}. Ubude bomugqa: {len}. Ububanzi bombhede: {w}. Ukuphakama: {z0} kuya {z1}.
pc.err.no_cloud: Leli fu alikho kwisitoreji salesi sibhrawuza.
pc.err.bad_cloud: Amafayela alelo fu awonakele noma avela enguqulweni ehlukile.
pc.err.building: Leli fu alizange liphele. Khetha ifayela futhi bese ucindezela Qhubeka.
pc.err.bad_source: Leli fayela alisiwona ifayela le-LAS noma le-LAZ elingafundwa yi-add-on.
pc.err.too_few_points: Amaphoyinti omhlaba awanele ukwenza indawo ephezulu. Qala ngokuthola umhlaba.
pc.err.no_surface: Ayikwazanga ukwenza indawo ephezulu kulawo maphoyinti.
pc.err.no_ground: Lokhu kudinga ukuthi umhlaba utholwe kuqala.
pc.err.resume_mismatch: Lelo ifayela alifani nelokhu ukwakha kwaqala ngalo.
pc.err.too_many_cells: Lokhu kucela amaseli amaningi kakhulu. Sebenzisa usayizi weseli omkhulu.
pc.err.laz_class_range: Kukhona iphoyinti elinesigaba esingaphezu kwe-31, okungenakho ukugcinwa amafomethi amaphoyinti e-LAZ 0 no-2. Liphume njenge-LAS 1.4, noma guqula leso sigaba kuqala.
pc.err.no_app: Vula imodeli kuqala: ifu liboniswa ebukweni be-3D bohlelo, olwenza imodeli yokuqala.
pc.err.no_3d: Ukubuka kwe-3D kohlelo akukatholakali okwamanje. Vula ukubuka kwe-3D bese uzama futhi.
pcx.note.bim: Idwetshwe ebukweni be-3D be-BimCraft ecaleni kwemodeli. Ama-LAS namaLAZ ahlelwe njengoba enjalo; i-E57, PLY, PCD, PTX, XYZ kanye ne-PTS ifundwa isifundi sohlelo (okungenani amaphoyinti ayi-3 million agciniwe, anciphisiwe ngokulinganayo) bese ihlelwa ngendlela efanayo. Kucatshangwa ukuthi amamitha, uma ifayela lingasho amafidi. Ukukhanyisa kwe-eye-dome kuvaliwe ekuqaleni lapha.
pcx.note.cad: Idwetshwe kuthebhu ye-3D ye-CadCraft. Ama-LAS namaLAZ ahlelwe njengoba enjalo; i-E57, PLY, PCD, PTX, XYZ kanye ne-PTS ifundwa isifundi sohlelo (okungenani amaphoyinti ayi-3 million agciniwe, anciphisiwe ngokulinganayo) bese ihlelwa ngendlela efanayo. Kucatshangwa ukuthi amamitha, uma ifayela lingasho amafidi. Amathuluzi womhlaba nesigaba akutholakali kuhlelo lwalo. Ukukhanyisa kwe-eye-dome kuvaliwe ekuqaleni lapha.
pcx.thinned: Ifayela linamaphoyinti {read}; {kept} agcinwe, asatazwa ngokulinganayo, ngaphambi kokuhlelwa.
